title: Define TUI replay and release gate strategy
purpose: Define replay, adversarial fixtures and release evidence required before claiming TUI-oriented AgentOS status.
scope: Define local TUI replay script inputs and outputs.
Define release provenance fields for TUI readiness.
acceptance_criteria: Replay covers submit, plan, advance, approve, deny, recover, audit, support and aom projection flows.
Adversarial command fixtures fail closed before EffectPrepared.
Release gate cannot mark TUI-oriented promotion if replay is missing or failed.
failure_modes: TUI readiness is claimed without replay.
Adversarial command injection is not represented.
